en.title: Malka RH
en.description: On this website, I created my first modal. Inside it, I embedded an iframe that connected to a customer service page within the client's system. Given that the company operates in the field of recruitment and selection and provides rapid customer service, I had to implement a condition for the modal to appear only during specific hours (from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. on weekdays), and I achieved this using JavaScript.
